name: bcontext
description: Bcontext: a self-hostable, MCP-first context layer for teams that work with AI agents.

scripts.build: npm run -s build -w @bcontext-dev/contract && npm run -s build -w bcontext-api && npm run -s build -w bcontext-web
scripts.test: npm run -s test -w @bcontext-dev/contract && npm run -s test -w bcontext-api && npm run -s test -w bcontext-web
scripts.verify: npm run -s verify -w @bcontext-dev/contract && npm run -s verify -w bcontext-api && npm run -s verify -w bcontext-web
